plan-tick.base_ref.description: Base ref of the range base..HEAD whose commits derive the plan tick of a PR (D-065 V4: the tick comes from commits, never from a checkbox the PR writes).

plan-tick.event_producer.description: Producer name of the pr.ready envelope (the forge_events port derives the idempotency key from it).

plan-tick.required_gate_kind.description: Gate plan whose passed gate.passed must exist for the head before pr.ready is emitted (gate-dev, tier 1).

plan-tick.short_sha_chars.description: Characters of a commit sha that pr.ready and the gate's pr.ready hook print (the event keeps the full sha).
